data.headline: Nasdaq grants AREC more time to regain listing compliance

claims.text: The company received an additional exception through November 16, 2026 to regain Nasdaq compliance by filing its delinquent March and June 2026 Form 10-Qs.

citation.quote: granting the Company an additional exception through November 16, 2026 to regain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) by filing its delinquent Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q for the periods ended March 31, 2026 (the “March Form 10-Q”) and June 30, 2026 (the “June Form 10-Q” and, together with the March Form 10-Q, the “Delinquent Filings”).

claims.text: The additional exception followed a subsequent delinquency associated with the June Form 10-Q and an updated compliance plan submitted to Nasdaq.

citation.quote: Following the subsequent delinquency associated with the June Form 10-Q, the Company submitted an updated compliance plan to Nasdaq requesting additional time to complete both Delinquent Filings.

claims.text: The Nasdaq letter has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the company’s Class A common stock, which continues under AREC.

citation.quote: The Nasdaq letter does not have any immediate effect on the listing or trading of the Company’s Class A common stock on The Nasdaq Capital Market, which continues to trade under the symbol “AREC.”

claims.text: Wyoming County Coal holds two coal mining permits in development, including faceup and infrastructure work, plus three permits tied to the Pioneer facilities and refuse impoundment.

citation.quote: Wyoming County Coal holds two coal mining permits that are in the development phase including faceup and infrastructure work and three permits associated with the idled Pioneer Preparation Plant, the Hatcher rail loadout, and Simmons Fork Refuse Impoundment.

claims.text: Those Wyoming County Coal permits remained in planning stages, with no mines currently in production.

citation.quote: The mining permits held by Wyoming County Coal are in various stages of planning with no mines currently in production.
